name: problem-statement-clean
text:
Current DDI datasets contain report-derived positives and sampled unreported pairs.

A credible model must:
• prevent A–B / B–A pair leakage;
• use chemically meaningful graph features; and
• test one-unseen-drug (S2) and both-unseen-drug (S1) generalization.

PxDDI therefore aims to be an auditable structure-based research pipeline—not a clinical safety or patient-risk tool.

name: scope-does
text:
PxDDI does

• Encodes two drug SMILES as molecular graphs
• Scores the experimental reported / unreported DDI task
• Adds an auxiliary FAERS-derived toxicity signal
• Saves audits, uncertainty and provenance artifacts

text:
PxDDI does not claim

• Patient-specific risk prediction
• Clinical decision support or prescribing advice
• That an unreported pair is safe
• External, temporal or prospective validation

name: objectives-clean
text:
1. Build a reproducible structure-based DDI pipeline from TWOSIDES pairs and an auxiliary FAERS-derived toxicity bridge.

2. Encode drug SMILES as molecular graphs and preserve DDI pair symmetry.

3. Compare edge-aware, motif-aware and cross-drug-attention candidates with a symmetric ECFP baseline.

4. Evaluate Transductive, S1, S2 and scaffold-disjoint protocols.

5. Produce calibrated, uncertainty-aware artifacts and a safe research-only API.
